//: Band button config. Copy this to config.json and edit. Each entry has a
//1: label/channel+msg plus EXACTLY ONE action of:
//2: launch : app name or absolute path, started detached (like double-click)
//3: shell  : a raw command line, run detached
//4: run    : name of a Python function registered with @register in actions.py
//5: Built-in run names: shutdown, media_playpause, action_center, fetch_homeassistant
//6: A 'when' condition (one of time/random/predicate) makes buttons appear only
//7: when it's true; no 'when' = always shown, re-checked each launcher arm.
//8: Put 'when' on a single button, OR on a GROUP { when, buttons:[...] } to share
//9: it across many. Groups nest; a button's own 'when' ANDs with its group's.
